title: The Crossing
subtitle: British Soul, 1977–1993
teaser: How a sound crossed the Atlantic, found a home in London and came back changed.
description: From Philadelphia and Detroit to the clubs of Soho and the bedrooms of Brixton, where a new kind of British soul was pressed in small runs and played until the grooves gave out.
quote: A record can be pressed in Birmingham and still sound like *it was born in Philadelphia.*
question: Which record carried *you* across a border?
